title: Oven Smoked Russian Kippers Paella
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Russian dish featuring kippers, smoked to perfection in a paella pan, with a charred and chewy texture, this show-off dish is sure to impress, it is a unique twist on traditional paella with the addition of russian kippers.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a paella pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture.
Add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding the next.
Once the rice is cooked, stir in the grated cheddar cheese until melted and well combined.
Arrange the kippers on top of the rice mixture in a single layer.
Cover the paella pan with aluminum foil and place in the oven.
Smoke the kippers by adding the binchotan charcoal to the oven, either by placing it in a foil packet or using a smoking gun.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the kippers are cooked through and the rice is lightly charred.
